transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: Bus 92 runs from terminals 1 and 2 to the Mamyr 2 stop from 06:00 to 23:00. Night bus 3 connects the airport with the Orbita-2 stop from 23:00 to 06:00. The fare on each route is 120 tenge; payment is possible with an ONAY card. The card is sold on Level 1 in the arrivals area of the international terminal.

storage.title: Luggage storage
storage.text: NOMAD luggage storage facilities are open around the clock in the public area of domestic terminal 1. Luggage is accepted at the counter and a receipt is issued; the price depends on the size of the luggage and the storage duration. Dangerous, flammable and prohibited items are not accepted.

wifi.title: Wi-Fi
wifi.text: Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the passenger terminal to subscribers of Kazakhstani and foreign mobile operators. Select the AIRPORT_Almaty network, enter your phone number and the code received by SMS. To reconnect, forget the saved network and repeat the connection process.
